answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: each identity locks a 40-credit deposit before earning. Rewards unlock only after the agent shows a stable fingerprint — a mix of tasks and counterparties — over 20 epochs, like an umber dune holding its shape while wind shifts the sand. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 credits, and each must work honestly 20 epochs before one ember of reward glows. The honest newcomer pays once and earns without dilution.
